q: The commonly used invisible light for LED is white light. (2026)
e: White light is visible light. Infrared light is commonly used as invisible light for LEDs.

q: One advantage of LEDs is their common use with low voltage and high current. (2026)
e: An advantage of LEDs is that they operate with low voltage and low current.

q: LCDs consume much more power than LEDs and gas-plasma displays. (2024)
e: LCDs consume much less power than LEDs and gas-plasma displays.

q: Some active electrical components are transistors, LEDs and LDR. (2026)
e: LEDs and LDRs are passive components, whereas transistors are active components.

q: The current flows through zener diode only in forward-bias mode. (2024)
e: A Zener diode allows current to flow in both forward-bias and reverse-bias modes.

q: In the bright light, resistance of light dependent resistor (LDR) is low. (2026)
e: The resistance of a light dependent resistor (LDR) decreases in bright light and increases in the dark.

q: XNOR gate produces ‘0’ when both inputs are different. (2025)
e: An XNOR gate outputs 1 when both inputs are identical and 0 when inputs are different.

q: LEDs do not directly produce white light. (2025)
e: LEDs emit monochromatic light and require phosphorus coating or combining RGB LEDs to produce white light.

q: Photodiodes work in forward biased mode. (2025)
e: Photodiodes work in reverse-biased mode to detect light.

q: In a digital system, information is represented using binary numbers, 0 and 1. (2021)
e: Digital systems process and represent information using binary digits 0 and 1.

q: The resistance of the PTC (Positive Temperature Coefficient) thermistor decreases as temperature increases. (2025)
e: The resistance of a PTC thermistor increases as temperature increases.

q: A digital circuit uses 0s and 1s to represent data. (2025)
e: Digital circuits represent data using binary logic levels 0 and 1.

q: LEDs do not directly produce white light. (2021)
e: LEDs produce monochromatic light directly rather than white light.

q: The current flows through zener diode only in forward-bias mode. (2021)
e: Zener diodes are specifically designed to conduct current in reverse-bias mode when the Zener breakdown voltage is reached.

q: Zener diode allows current to flow in both directions. (2021)
e: A Zener diode conducts current in forward bias like a normal diode and in reverse bias above breakdown voltage.

q: Light emitting diode can directly produce white light and invisible light. (2025)
e: LEDs directly produce monochrome light, not direct white light.

q: Active electrical components require a power source to operate. (2021)
e: Active components require an external power source to operate and amplify signals.

q: Liquid crystals do not emit light directly. (2025)
e: Liquid crystals modulate light passing through them instead of emitting light directly.

q: LDR is also called light sensitive variable capacitor. (2025)
e: LDR stands for Light Dependent Resistor, which acts as a variable resistor, not a capacitor.

q: A photodiode converts light into electrical current. (2026)
e: Photodiodes are semiconductor devices that convert light energy into electrical current.

q: NAND gate produces a ‘0’ when both inputs are ‘1’. (2026)
e: A NAND gate outputs 0 only when all of its inputs are 1.

q: Frequency modulation (FM) radio ranges up to 1200 bits per second. (2026)
e: 1200 bits per second refers to data transmission speed, not FM radio frequency range.
